name: Sarah
subject: Can you rush a donation to our campaign?
body:
Thanks so much for reading this email!
#
Hi, it's Sarah McBride.
I know it’s a Sunday night, so thank you so much for taking the time to read this email.
I connected with my team, and candidly, we’re still a few dozen grassroots donations from reaching our $25,000 end-of-quarter goal. **With just a few hours left until midnight, we’re running out of time to bridge the gap.**
[**As we come down to the wire, can you rush a donation of $5, $25, $50, or anything at all to our campaign for Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240630-2?refcode=em20240630-2-731&refcode2=731_21716_Se7Soq&akid=731%2E21716%2ESe7Soq)
This is our last quarterly fundraising deadline before the Delaware candidate filing deadline and primary election. And after tonight, I’ll have to announce my fundraising totals publicly.
This deadline is our chance to show the strength of our coalition to voters and the media — and also show right-wing donors that they can’t stop us.
**That’s why I’m asking one last time:**
**[Please consider rushing a donation — of any amount — to continue building a historic grassroots movement to finally elect an out trans representative to the halls of Congress.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240630-2?refcode=em20240630-2-731&refcode2=731_21716_Se7Soq&akid=731%2E21716%2ESe7Soq)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240630-2?amount=5&refcode=em20240630-2-731&refcode2=731_21716_Se7Soq&akid=731%2E21716%2ESe7Soq)**
Thank you for having my back!
Sarah McBride

**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240630-2&t=1&refcode2=731_21716_Se7Soq&akid=731%2E21716%2ESe7Soq)**

body:
We are closer to our $20,000 June goal.
Peter, I hope you’ve enjoyed your Sunday so far.

June Update

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/ppp2gaxknr-12700009?e=8f9fef7158)
June Update
Friends and Fellow Hoosiers,

June is Men's Mental Health Awareness Month. As we close out this month, please check in on the men in your life. Suicide is the 7th leading cause of death among men in the U.S. If you or someone you know is struggling, please call 9-8-8.

Be sure to check out the events at the bottom of the newsletter - I look forward to seeing you throughout the state as we host mental health roundtables!

Suzanne Crouch
2nd Annual Indiana Mental Health Roundtable Summit
This year, the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable hosted our second annual summit. We were thrilled to have a sold out event!

Our children are facing a mental health crisis - suicide is the second leading cause of death amongst Hoosier teens. The focus of this year's summit was to address the mental health crisis facing our youth.

LEARN MORE ABOUT INDIANA MENTAL HEALTH ROUNDTABLE (https://mentalhealthroundtable.org/2024-imhr-summit/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d844d78655-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Reagan Institute Summit on Education

I had the honor of participating in the Reagan Institute's Summit on Education for a fireside chat about mental health, particularly in regards to the increase of anxiety and depression amongst our youth.

If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54441?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54442?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54441?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg)

**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.
**[FIGHT BACK: ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54441?refcode=em20240630-5904&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=5904%2E614464%2EPlG8dg)**
Just as we saw in elections across the country — both last year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.

Jason Kander

It’s go time! 30 days until the primary election! And 6 hours before our end-of-quarter deadline.

It would mean a lot to me if you chipped in $3 or any amount, and then please read on about why this deadline is uniquely important for our campaign:

[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw-q2-2024?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87993099/482864067/-1414337131?refcode=em-6.30.24-all-2-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTAxYTlhNWYtNDUzNy1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5HfQdfOYpLR6Gjw6y2xJbClBYKz_Oypixmve4tKaIi8=)

This is the final stretch before we go up against MAGA David Schweikert, and tonight’s deadline is one of our last chances to publicly show our strength.

Since we’re required by the FEC to make the last three months of our fundraising public, everyone – from our supporters to David Schweikert and the national GOP – will see how we performed.

I’m confident that we are the campaign that will flip this seat blue and help win back control of Congress, but we can’t stop now.

We’re pushing TV and digital ads, planting yard signs, holding events, and doing everything in our power to get our movement in front of the undecided voters we need to win.

Schweikert only won this district by 3,200 votes last cycle. Your $3 donation could make the difference.

Please, chip in here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw-q2-2024?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87993100/482864068/-1414337131?refcode=em-6.30.24-all-2-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTAxYTlhNWYtNDUzNy1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5HfQdfOYpLR6Gjw6y2xJbClBYKz_Oypixmve4tKaIi8=)

Thank you,

Marlene Galán-Woods

A little over two years ago, the Supreme Court issued its decision in _Dobbs_ , in which _Roe v. Wade_ was overruled.

A number of people regarded a Wisconsin law dating back to the mid-1800s as a broad criminal abortion ban, and, for more than a year after the issuance of _Dobbs_ , abortion was largely inaccessible in Wisconsin.

Four days after the Supreme Court’s ruling in _Dobbs_ , Governor Evers and I announced a lawsuit seeking to restore abortion access in Wisconsin. **June 30, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi Readers,
As President Joe Biden grapples with the fallout from a challenging debate performance, speculation swirls about the Democratic Party potentially seeking a new nominee for the upcoming election. Here's what could unfold:
* The Democratic National Committee (DNC) has a provision for nominating a new candidate during the convention if Biden chooses to withdraw. This process, which hasn't been used in decades, would involve an open nominating procedure on the convention floor.
* While Biden secured approximately 95% of the nearly 4,000 delegates during the primaries, these delegates are not legally bound to vote for him, allowing room for an alternative nomination if a significant number shift their support.
* If Biden steps down, the convention could become a battleground for various candidates across the Democratic spectrum, potentially including Vice President Kamala Harris and governors like Gavin Newsom and Gretchen Whitmer, among others.
* Superdelegates, who now have limited power, could play a crucial role if no candidate secures a majority on the first ballot, turning the convention into a contested event where over 700 party insiders would have significant influence.
* The dynamics of selecting a new vice presidential candidate could also introduce another layer of complexity, particularly if Harris secures the nomination and seeks a running mate.
* The Heritage Foundation notes that several states, including key swing states like Georgia, Nevada, and Wisconsin, may not permit a substitute candidate on the ballot. This restriction could endanger the Democrats' prospects in these critical areas, leading to considerable legal disputes and political instability. Additionally, this situation could influence voter turnout and engagement, possibly impacting other races on the ballot.

Stay tuned as we navigate these rocky political waters leading up to the Democratic convention.
Have a great week ahead,
Heidi Ganahl

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: we’re not doing as well as I would like
body:
We may have to cut back on some of our plans...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I have an upcoming strategy meeting with _Students for Life Action’s_ Board of Directors, and I’m not feeling good about it.

You see, our **End of Quarter Push** isn’t doing as well as I hoped it would . . . I was hoping we’d meet our marks and then blow right past them!

The good news is we still can – if I can count on good folks like you to give generously.

**[So, can you please agree to your most generous contribution to ensure that we not only meet, but SURPASS, our End of Quarter Push](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gyhhljl-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, we simply can’t lose momentum now.

While the Abortion Lobby is sitting pretty with their blood-soaked millions and $700 million in taxpayer cash, _Students for Life Action_ relies on good people like you to help fund our efforts.

And our efforts are working.

Democrats are already running scared because we’re taking back their coveted demographic — Millennials and Gen Z.

_Even the media has started to freak out!_

_NPR_ just reported, “Biden’s Problems With Younger Voters Are Glaring, Poll Finds.”

A BIG reason for this is your help, along with our efforts to convert young people to the pro-life cause!

But our critical work can only keep going with your support!

All the successes we’ve had together won’t matter one bit if we don’t finish 2024 strong.

If the Abortion Lobby reinstalls their puppet President Joe Biden in the White House, seizes back control of the House, and holds their Senate Majority, they have pledged that they will immediately move to:

**>>> _Force abortion-on-demand throughout all nine months of a pregnancy on every state in the country_** – and force hardworking taxpayers like you and me to pay for it;
**>>> _Force EVERYONE who works in the medical field to commit abortions on demand_ ,** removing any and all “conscience” protections for doctors, nurses, and pharmacists;
**>>> _Outlaw Pregnancy Resource Centers_** for daring to help women choose Life. Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) has already introduced the _“Stop Anti-Abortion Disinformation Act”_ to muzzle pro-life centers and even stated on the Senate floor that, _“Deception is at the heart of many [pregnancy help centers;”_ and
**>>> _IMPEACH Supreme Court Justices _(or else pack the Court)_ to ensure NO ONE can stand in their way_.** As one headline from The Nation put it, “Impeach Samuel Alito! Impeach Clarence Thomas!”
**[So, please chip in what you can to give _Students for Life Action_ a shot in the arm before the June 30th End of Quarter Deadline](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gyhhljl-duchtdja-j/).**

Let’s ensure we keep them on the ropes and double-down our efforts to abolish abortion.

_And I’m counting on you to help make that happen._

**Because without support from good folks like you, we risk losing ALL of the hard-earned ground we gained with the fall of _Roe._**

It’s up to us, and I appreciate you being here in the good fight.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Scott Baugh
subject: June Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Baugh for Congress
body:
|
---
| |
---
| Peter, June was an incredible month of long days and hard work, but I am excited by the momentum on our side. As we roll into the summer, come spend some time with our team, as we work for you to restore common sense principles in our community.
---
| |
---
**Look who joined us at the office! These bright smiles remind us why we’re dedicated to securing a better world. This generation is our future- they are the leaders, innovators, and changemakers of tomorrow. Let’s work together to ensure a safe, prosperous, and free world for them to thrive in.**
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
**I had the pleasure of attending a BBQ in support of James Mai for Irvine City Council District 3. It was a wonderful gathering where our community came together to listen and share ideas. We were honored to have Dr. Stefan Bean, Superintendent of Public Instruction, join us and offer words of support, particularly on the critical issue of education. It’s moments like these that remind us of the power of community and the importance of working together for a better future.**
|
---
In June, our campaign did a record-breaking amount of door-knocking, as we talked to voters in every community of our district. Thank you to everyone who came to support our efforts and volunteer their time, we couldn't have done it without you.
|
---
**Always fun campaigning on island time! Thank you to everyone who came to meet our campaign. Seeing the outpouring of support and patriotism in our community was incredible, and it is always fun to connect with new voters. It may be little, but there is a big spirit in Little Balboa!**
|
---
**Education is the cornerstone of a healthy and prosperous society. We need leaders who will support education, protect parental rights, and preserve a future where students can flourish.**
|
---
**We had a lovely morning and robust conversations at our Bagels with Baugh event, as we discussed the issues that matter to us. Our district is home to a vibrant Jewish community that deserves a leader who will stand proudly with Israel and deliver results for the American people.**
|
---
**I am incredibly proud of the 70 students who graduated from Pacifica Christian High School this month. We just finished our 9th year and our 7th graduation of seniors. We have succeeded in our vision to create a school with a rigorous curriculum for students, rooted in the Classics and Western Civilization, and refined with intellectual hospitality. Each year we celebrate the Pacifica community with students, parents, administrators, teachers, and a growing alumni. To all of the graduating students, may you continue to work hard, chase life-long learning, and excel in the art of thinking and living well.**
|
---
**A beautiful and sunny evening at home in the 47th. I want to thank our hosts for a great event, and to all the wonderful people who came out to support our shared belief in the American Dream. Together, brighter days are ahead for our country and our community.**
|
---
We are blessed in this district to be home to a vibrant and warm Chinese-American community. What a great experience meeting the team and speaking about the issues that matter to us all. Congratulations to two new US citizens Jack Fang and Paul Song. Thank you AG One Realty for hosting. By working together, and sharing our values, that is how we build a more perfect union.
|
---
**Keep on “riding” in the free world! What an awesome display of patriotism and community at the Huntington Beach 4th of July Bike Cruise. This great event highlights everything we love about our city of HB, and it was great to see many familiar faces in the crowd. Thank you Ed Romo for putting this all together yet again.**
|
---
|
---
**We had a heartwarming visit from Dr. Steven Choi, running for State Senate, along with a wonderful group of moms with their children. They came to our office to phone bank and show their support for our campaign. Their dedication and community spirit are truly inspiring, and together, we are strengthening our community and paving the way for positive change.**

body:
We Need You at HQ July 6! | | | | | [](https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=2137fa55f2&e=98be86514c)
---
|
# SHERIFF JOE ARPAIO ENDORSES KIM GEORGE!
---
|
---
|
# KIM IS GUEST ON
# FOX AND FRIENDS FIRST
---
| Kim joins Fox to discuss border security and recent tragedies due to an open border. Fox News, June 24, 2024.
---
[Click Here To See Interview](https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=da3ee85a40&e=98be86514c)
|
---
|
# KIM WINS SEVERAL
# GOLDEN TICKETS!
---
| Golden Tickets are created by individual Legislative Districts (LD) and independent organizations, for both the primary and general elections, and have the names of top picks for each race. Tickets are often developed after interviewing candidates and researching the voting records of those already holding office. Tickets are distributed door-to-door and can serve as a guide for Republican voters, who may not be familiar with the candidates running for office. Kim was ranked as the top Republican pick for Congressional District (CD) 1 by several organizations.
Members of LD2 conducted a straw poll and Kim was selected as the candidate for CD1.
Members of LD3 conducted a straw poll and Kim received 79.3% of the vote.
LD4 and LD5 also listed Kim as their pick for US Congress in CD1.
The National Freedom Coalition endorsed Kim as their official pick for CD1 and said “We the People of the National Freedom Coalition support and back Kim George for Congressional District 1. We know that Kim will be one of the best candidates fighting for the rights of the People of Arizona in DC.”
---
|
---
|
# KIM IS RECOMMENDED BY
# PIVOT USA!
---
|
---
|
# KIM MEETS CONSTITUENTS THROUGHOUT CD1
---
| Kim’s campaign continues to be non-stop, meeting people throughout the district at every chance she gets. She’s spoken at numerous political party meetings, Meet & Greets and fundraisers, and a variety of other types of events and places. Every day is filled with opportunities to introduce herself and her campaign to the constituents.
We are hearing that people are spreading the word about Kim George and what a great Congresswoman she will make!
You, too, can help get Kim’s name out there! If you have friends and neighbors you can invite to your home, Kim will come and speak with them. Just email info@kimgeorgeforarizona.com to request to host a Meet and Greet. We want to get as many of these scheduled before the primary election July 30th.
You can also help by forwarding this newsletter to your friends and neighbors, and telling them about Kim.
---
|
---
|
# MARICOPA COUNTY VOTER DASHBOARD
---
| What Legislative District do I reside in? Who are my elected officials? How do I make sure I am still registered to vote? Can I see my voting history? How do I temporarily have my ballot sent to another address? Where is my polling place?
All these questions can be answered in one place at the Maricopa County Voter Registration and Elections website. Click the button below.
---
[Voter Dashboard](https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=7a86083e20&e=98be86514c)
|
---
|
# CALLING ALL VOLUNTEERS!
---
| Your help is needed at campaign headquarters on Saturday, July 6, from 9am-1pm!
We will be placing address labels and postage on thousands of postcards. They will go throughout CD1 asking our Republican neighbors to vote for Kim on July 30.
Bring a sack lunch if you’d like. We’ll provide beverages and snacks.
HQ: 10603 N. Hayden Road, Suite 108, Scottsdale
---
|
---
|
# UPCOMING EVENTS
---
|
# RADIO INTERVIEW SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, JULY 1, 4-6PM
---
|
---
|
---
|
# JULY 1st DEADLINE
---
| Voters must be registered by July 1 to vote in the July 30th primary election. To register online, visit servicearizona.com. You must have a valid Arizona driver’s license or identification card. You will be emailed a confirmation after you complete the registration process.
---
[ServiceArizona.com](https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=f2f15fac8d&e=98be86514c)
|
---
|
# Primary Vote—Tuesday, July 30th
---
| Mark your calendar now to vote! This race is too important to miss! If you’re going to be out-of-town, use the Secretary of State’s online portal to request a ballot-by-mail for the Primary and/or General Election.
---
|
---
|
# About Kim George
---
| Kim George is a retired FBI Special Agent with over two decades of experience in law enforcement and investigations. Now she is running to represent Arizona's First Congressional District to fight to protect our national security and ensure our law enforcement has what they need to enforce the law.
Voters can learn more about Kim’s campaign at [www.KimGeorgeForArizona.com](https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=f73193d120&e=98be86514c).
---
|
---
|
## Did you know???
---
| **One large “Kim For Congress” sign you see at a street corner costs $35! Now multiply that for all the signs needed along all the roadways throughout the entire First Congressional District and we’re talking thousands of dollars!**
Kim has to raise money to get her message out. Now more than ever, the campaign needs your show of support. Can you help her with a financial contribution today? No donation is too small! $10, $20, $50—anything helps!
Click below to donate with a credit card, or you can mail a check to the campaign P.O. Box:
Kim George For Arizona7339 E. Williams Drive, #25866Scottsdale, AZ 85255-9998
Checks should be made out to “Kim George For Arizona.” Please make a note with your name, address, and occupation (campaign funding regulations).

# Why is Titus Ignoring the People She Represents?
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter:
Dina Titus was recently featured in a front-page article in the Las Vegas Sun Newspaper. Did Titus talk about the open border? Nope! That remains a critical unsettled issue. Did Titus talk about inflation ravaging Nevada families? NO. She can't handle that issue. Did Titus talk about jobs and the economy? Of course not. She's afraid of that. Did Titus talk about school choices that parents want? Really? There's no way she'll support parents. Did Titus talk about crime and drugs killing Nevadans? Not a word. She can't be bothered. Did Titus talk about Social Security and Medicaid? NO! She has no plan to save them. So, if Titus isn't talking about the most important issues, what is she talking about? Abortion. That's right, she's talking about the one issue already settled in Nevada. The people of Nevada have already settled the abortion question. A referendum of the people created a law that allows abortion in Nevada up to 24 weeks of pregnancy for any reason or no reason at all. After 24 weeks, abortion is still legal to save the life and health of the mother. Neither the governor nor the legislature can change this law - only the people of Nevada can change it. In overturning Roe, the Supreme Court stated abortion is not a federal issue and that it should be settled by the States and by "we, the people." ## Biden Consults with Family on Future
President Biden traveled to Camp David this weekend to discuss the [future of his re-election](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAUAH8N7rDggeO4oLjGXa690uLjEb8TBgvYWPn3q2y99RQzmn-P7WEpUX7-tQeaHstmfacXbjOXHPSmh2AiIqAa0MhZLnct9SKG3WDQzmn0bgGBatJR3cU0Ka0dBIvRD2RAgBazkFIIqaYRQd4gSKUA7zc5WaYFBuqljv8L5b5jTO_ywjr6cgzJ7L2fjak_DFYG63VdY3Y-49U-nMF6lkSdfGOwfkQcE_pOJTNYHQXMPNqD0puftu88lnrZGnigZluv5avxgM525Ae2xqvPVk7LtMihmnBelBK128y0eB6W0k9R_3XPy8B3AAAA__94tWh9) campaign with his wife Jill, as well as children and grandchildren, following Thursday's dismal debate performance. Democratic Party leaders' public support for Biden remains firm, but many in the media and some strategists are recommending that he withdraw from the race. One close adviser summarized the situation like this: ["It's a mess."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH8N3rDgQfwxMHTxlq4dLQKP-LVgLKBx8--rdO58Oul0H9f1ainSfn-3CU0LebWu0QPXkUsOetWdNwERUHVo5CjnSUs9i24zKJzVSs8uDMHpeQZ_GSfhYR4nqwYbOjIgQItRSCmEVJceQQ7gpVKA0yAvlmmBnlou_WemvW0Y4jM_sPQupy6arbWjMvXGYGGwnOfZh_yz41lfnMGS0JNlsNzI484LHrk09PHJt-9EkWxDzz3ebEN-YAm5JLs75NG6r8pd3sPLc8ipVZ6w1q4Yf5wUI9VhZFrck6X419L-HfMw8BsAAP__VoFoGw) Biden's top advisers emphasized that any decision would be personal and made in [consultation with his wife.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGuqzAQRL_GdBvZiwOhcPEad3ntLZGDl7CRwQgvRPz9VVLfaUczOjo_9_4eOPHy_B9mcjLmPgzCB_UtGEDb2yq6kQiprsiZ1nQ3a2ynq8npRxyuhDEY25I1n4zGdk3oulrHm6nYoUarW22M1qa-XghNg9HUNdKtMdegrKbIkrfLK_MiE43pzAdtlyHPVXKTyFpU_U-hV-iXc81FPpVC_zlW6HWj0Ndaod8LLPQuCv2DIy0w5UQR9hWCwBDmFWI4OMKbZYKRtyKQQjzhxSnBGGZOJ0iGyGXYS_kuAj-XAuMu-0aw0Zo3UeirzcX1zSlxaVpl9XMOnL688qe8w-FvAAAA__9U2HEk) They also said the trip to Camp David had been planned before the debate as a photo session, not a strategy meeting. For now, top party officials say that while the debate was a bad night, Biden remains a strong candidate who won't drop out. At the same time, the New York Times [published an editorial Sunday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQxvGnwU6HXUG0oEhDd2lTOkSWu01QHOXO8e0zJm26X_EV__k-buPNc-Ll_u5nsiXm0U-FXzSaGmpUo6qCjURIbUUWDAy9AjXI6mEl6tgpHfsoB5oiRIDW62kYjKZuQKjYokQljQSQElrdEEKHAdoWqe9Ae6EkBS55a74yL-VBMZ35RVsz5blK9lHKuov2TaAT6I7jaJ67Lzn48xoIdHvJ2ynQLXTsAt2aExeeLlKiqXBeLl8RAp3sLvd_8_rM23ddeKa9_uRASx22vNb5WQQ6o1CDRpDSCHTVZsN6cEq8d0YoeZ89p9_C8u9dL4s_AQAA__8bpWkh) saying Biden should step aside.
## States Battle Over Tracking Gun Sales
Beginning today, a new law in California requires major credit card companies to track retail gun sales. New laws in Georgia, Iowa, Tennessee, and Wyoming [do the exact opposite](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQRb_G7oiYAYNdUGyTLttuaY1hsFlhEwGbaP_-Ka9-5dUtztH581gflHK69t90suuxrOR7evFqBQjUqx6Di8zIamQHFpZZg17keDgvrddkYDLGT5vFLUhQW7BRRQto_ZgcStTSSgApQU03RjAYQCnk2cBEg5YcUi_19rekqx8c8__y4nrz5RyzO3p_tkH9GvA-4J2eF7_b5_qM2pPPPOB9_3eJ1kvlJmKqTPVs4qTWRDtK6enam_D1QxGeamiCNlaEM5MFsErLsJCmefOBlVlU5LG68HynnFMzdtByPynlb6H-Y52Xw68AAAD__3b4ZsI), and ban any credit card tracking of firearm sales. The conflicting laws are a new battleground in gun policy debates, being pushed by gun control advocates as a way to flag unusual gun purchases and blocked by gun rights advocates who say the special tracking would sweep up innocent gun buyers. Since 2023, 17 GOP-led states have passed measures prohibiting or limiting the tracking. Last week, [Tennessee's attorney general](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2unDAQRp_GdINsY_4KF9mCbiOlSUo0MgM4MTayDYi3j9jiVrc9Z6Sj-f68xzdaZ_3yEzfSeQ4jmmxPGlsQINWoiknPRJKqgrRoRd8poXperNrUPfV1T4pjY-qqU6ikwZY3qhecq7mwWnKpeMuF4FxUdUlSNHISVSWpa0SNTHGabA6x_BuszyvN7g4nxdKErXB6zXlPrPrB5MDkcF1XuSX_OCYH8nAkJocteLqZHEzYdvSWHoY5h-jphoU8RXRwYfQJTHxiYDBO8HUOYYa04r_7g5xFbwgum1dYDg_7Ec2KiSAd8STr3Ec7vJ5KhNdL7PxX97uIetov65xNTcsUXza07vNE_nbRU8v_AQAA___l73sC) warned the three major credit card companies to comply with the state's new law. On this day in 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg began and lasted until July 3. It was a turning point for the Union in the Civil War and one of its deadliest battles. () What a nice Monday! It's a holiday week, with the Fourth of July fast approaching. That makes today much easier than usual, and we hope you feel the same. Did you find some stories of value in today's Flyover? Let us know how we're doing by replying to this e-mail. Be sure to check out today's sponsor . | Biden Consults with Family on Future President Biden traveled to Camp David this weekend to discuss the campaign with his wife Jill, as well as children and grandchildren, following Thursday's dismal debate performance. July 1, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Nancy Dahlstrom Statement on Supreme Court Presidential Immunity Ruling

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, the Supreme Court upheld centuries of
presidential and legal tradition by agreeing with President Trump and
cementing presidential immunity in American law. This decision by the
Supreme Court preserves the power of the presidency and ensures that
past, current, and future presidents are free from legal action over
the hard decisions they had to make in their post.

"Today's decision by the Supreme Court ensures that our presidents are
able to effectively do their jobs without fear of legal repercussions
for making tough calls," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said in a
statement. "I applaud the Supreme Court for preserving the power of the
presidency and our national security with this ruling."

| | July 1, 2024
I approach the Primary as a contest about which candidate can best prosecute the case against the incumbent, while effectively championing the principles and values of the Republican Party. For the past year I've conducted a campaign of persistent-offense against Jim Himes, exposing his abysmal voting record, always offering the Conservative Republican solution to any issue at which Himes has failed. I pledge to the citizens of the 4th District not to contest this race on a political battlefield defined by the Democrats and the American Left.
For the past twenty years and more, the activist Left aligned with the broad array of Democrat mouthpieces, have continually polarized the effective Republican figures - those publicly making the case against the destructive Democrat agenda. Then, with media support, they proceed to make them too 'radioactive' to be associated or aligned with. Then, through coordinated repetition and intimidation they build a media-amplified chorus to make our most effective and potent issues 'radioactive' as well. One of the main purposes of this strategy is to turn our most effective people and issues into a sort of political minefield, to be avoided by the balance of Republicans. The desired effect of this quite cunning Alinskyite strategy is to transform a challenging issues battlefield into one more favorable to the Leftist Democrat agenda. Unfortunately, this has worked successfully in Blue-Captured Connecticut. With corporate media flying cover and enforcement, the political atmosphere has become intimidating for Republicans to simply speak the truth of what we see with our own eyes. The result is too many Republican candidates swerve around the targeted political figures, and dilute the potency of their best issues. Too often reacting and responding to this minefield, the Republican candidate appears to stand for nothing, or a milder version of the Democrat agenda, which is destroying the country. I simply refuse to 'swerve' to accommodate their agenda. Another deception deployed against Republicans is the idea that the large swath of the CT electorate (roughly 40%) registered as Unaffiliated, are 'moderates' who just want to hear 'reasonable solutions.' Some may be, but over the past 15 years of speaking to them in the District, I hear most indicate they are 'Unaffiliated' from the major parties for a reason. Many see the Democrats as deceptive, and in recent years as on the wrong track. However, they don't see enough Republicans standing firmly against the Democrat agenda, and when they do, they see too little follow up with action where it counts. I firmly contend the majority of Unaffiliateds seek a candidate who will take a principled stance on the issues of the day, and not waver under attack. We Republicans champion the right principles, values, and solutions for the current times - and the solid citizens of CT-4 need to hear them loud, clear, and unwavering from our candidates. That is why I entered the race, and I have not hesitated in championing our principles, and contrasting them with the failed record of the incumbent, Himes. Regardless of the candidate, if the 4th District race closes in the polls, the Republican will face the politico-media smear and attack machine. I've faced it all before in my grassroots organizing days, in both local and national forums. I am best seasoned and prepared to handle hostile press. I'm running an energetic primary effort in all 17 towns of the District, and organizing a ground game which will drive us thru the General as well. I continue to believe I am the candidate for this time.

body:
Defend America this week
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** On Thursday, we will celebrate the glorious independence of our great nation. There will be parties, parades, fireworks, burgers and kids with American flags painted on their faces. It is a wonderful time for America, and a wonderful time for her people.
As we reflect on the amazing courage it took for our forefathers to sign the Declaration of Independence in direct defiance of the tyrannical British government, we have to remember the infamous words of Benjamin Franklin when asked what kind of government was created: "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Now, more than ever, it is crucial that we unite together to stop the tyrannical left from destroying everything that this country was founded upon. [**And it starts with supporting our Supreme Court.**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a13551d3/1edb9794a08bdd33 "And it starts with supporting our Supreme Court.")
Our Supreme Court has been under heavy attack from the radical left, as you well know, and it's time the American people stood strong with our conservative justices and the institution of the Court.
Below are three actions we are asking you to take this week. **** ************
---
| **ACTION ITEM**
---
| | _You_ can make the difference by reaching out to your elected officials and telling them that you support our Supreme Court and that the moves to shake confidence in their decisions will not work, and that _ _ you _don 't_ support the radical leftist agenda to pack the court with additional justices. This insanity must stop.
---
| |
---
| **ACTION ITEM**
---
| | Since you have them on the phone, tell your elected officials that you support the SAVE Act (introduced in the Senate by Mike Lee (R-UT) and in the House by Chip Roy (R-TX), because only citizens should vote in this country. The SAVE Act requires proof of citizenship before registering to vote, and every member of Congress should support this legislation.
---
| |
---
| **ACTION ITEM**
---
| | Additionally, every year we encourage you to read the Declaration of Independence aloud to your family and/or your guests during your Independence Day celebration. Since our schools don't want to teach accurate American history, it is up to each of us to pass the torch of freedom on to future generations. [**Use this online copy**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a13551d3/1edb9794a08bdd35 "https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/declaration-transcript") if you don't have one in your house, but I always recommend having a paper copy of it and the Constitution in your home.
---
| **** Taking action this week is one of the most patriotic things we can do to honor the sacrifices made by our Founding Fathers. However, I recommend you do them early in the week so that you can take July 4th to relax and celebrate with family and friends.

Happy Independence Day! **** ************
---
| **** In liberty,

Jenny Beth Martin **** ************

clean_body: Defend America this week | | | | | | Patriot- | ** On Thursday, we will celebrate the glorious independence of our great nation. There will be parties, parades, fireworks, burgers and kids with American flags painted on their faces. It is a wonderful time for America, and a wonderful time for her people. As we reflect on the amazing courage it took for our forefathers to sign the Declaration of Independence in direct defiance of the tyrannical British government, we have to remember the infamous words of Benjamin Franklin when asked what kind of government was created: "A Republic, if you can keep it." Now, more than ever, it is crucial that we unite together to stop the tyrannical left from destroying everything that this country was founded upon. "And it starts with supporting our Supreme Court." Our Supreme Court has been under heavy attack from the radical left, as you well know, and it's time the American people stood strong with our conservative justices and the institution of the Court. Below are three actions we are asking you to take this week. ******** | ACTION ITEM | | You can make the difference by reaching out to your elected officials and telling them that you support our Supreme Court and that the moves to shake confidence in their decisions will not work, and that you don 't support the radical leftist agenda to pack the court with additional justices. This insanity must stop. | | | ACTION ITEM | | Since you have them on the phone, tell your elected officials that you support the SAVE Act (introduced in the Senate by Mike Lee (R-UT) and in the House by Chip Roy (R-TX), because only citizens should vote in this country. Since our schools don't want to teach accurate American history, it is up to each of us to pass the torch of freedom on to future generations. ## Historical Marker Dedication
_(Tamina, Texas)_
I attended the County Historical Marker Dedication Ceremony for the Sweet Rest Cemetery. There is so much rich history in this Freedman settlement in Montgomery County, established in 1871. The descendants of the original homesteaders are dedicated to preserving their legacy and heritage. It was touching to hear stories of community members passed down through generations.

| | | | | | | | | | |
# #WearOrange
_(Texas)_
Children dying by gun violence is a uniquely American tragedy. I wore orange on National Gun Violence Awareness Day because no child should live in fear of gun violence—in their schools, neighborhoods, or anywhere.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=d6a37bc035&e=a2a46ff12c)
| |
## Polk County Democrats
_(Livingston, Texas)_
Great turnout at the Polk County Democrats Summer Celebration Event. Grateful to see dedicated activists and meet new faces. Your support means the world to me as I strive to represent Polk County and all of Congressional District 8.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=4aba8a6999&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | | | |
## Juneteenth Celebration
_(Coldspring, Texas)_
The Juneteenth Celebration hosted by the Friends of Hopewell today was uplifting! This is the 3rd year and each year attendance grows. It’s an honor to celebrate such an important part of Texas history with members of my own community! I look forward to next year’s celebration.

---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=6137a2a7da&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
# Pride Celebration
_(Katy, Texas)_
I joined the Katy Area Democrats to celebrate Pride month. In the fight for justice, diversity, and inclusion, we stand united to ensure that every individual is treated with dignity and respect, regardless of their background, identity, or orientation. Let's continue to advocate for a society where everyone has equal opportunities and rights, and where diversity is embraced as a source of strength and enrichment.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=f911f58223&e=a2a46ff12c)
| |
## Volunteering for Juneteenth
_( Tamina, Texas)_
Attended a vibrant Juneteenth Celebration in the historic freedman's town of Tamina, Montgomery County! Enjoyed delicious food, fantastic entertainment, and engaging conversations with local residents. Huge thanks to Mrs. Rita Wiltz and the dedicated team at Children's Books on Wheels for their commitment to their community. Had a wonderful time volunteering alongside my friend, Jane Kelso Winter from Mom's Demand Action.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=cae1d2af8e&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | | | |
## Roe v. Wade Event
_(Katy, Texas)_
Last week marked the 2nd Anniversary of the **Dobb’s decision** , a pivotal moment when the Supreme Court struck down **Roe v. Wade** , a 50-year-old Constitutional Freedom. I had the honor of attending an insightful event hosted by the Indivisible Katy Huddle group, featuring speaker Kylie McNaught, Director of public affairs for Planned Parenthood Gulf Coast.In this upcoming election ACTION is the key! Let's stand together and support candidates at every level who will champion and restore our Reproductive Freedoms!

---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0ba65a08f3&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
|
---
| **Legislative Update**
In June 2024, several significant bills were passed in Congress. On June 28th, H.R. 8771, Dept of State Appropriations, passed with a vote of 212-200, with 20 members present or not voting; Congressman Luttrell voted yes. The same day, H.R. 8752, Homeland Security Appropriations, passed 212-203, with 17 present or not voting; Luttrell also voted yes. Additionally, H.R. 8774, Dept of Defense Appropriations, passed 217-198, with 17 present or not voting, and Luttrell voted yes. Earlier, H.R. 2784, American Cooperation With Our Neighbors, passed with a resounding 368-19, with 44 present or not voting, and Luttrell voted yes. H.R. 8070, Service Member Quality of Life & National Defense Authorization, passed 217-199, with 15 present or not voting; Luttrell voted yes. H. Res. 1292, Attorney General Merrick Garland Contempt of Congress, passed 216-207, with 8 present or not voting, with Luttrell voting yes. H.R. 2964, WIPPES Act (Water Infrastructure Pollution Prevention & Environmental Safety), passed 351-56, with 23 present or not voting, and H.R. 6543, No Hidden Fees, passed 384-25, with 21 present or not voting; Luttrell voted yes on both. H.R. 8580, Military Construction, Veterans Affairs & Related Agencies Appropriations, passed 209-197, with 25 present or not voting; Luttrell voted yes. H.R. 8282, Illegitimate Court Counter Action (to impose sanctions on international Criminal Court actions against protected Americans & Allies), passed 247-155, with 29 present or not voting; Luttrell voted yes. Finally, H.R. 1215, Elected Officials & Public Officials educating the public on contributions of the American Jewish Community, passed 371-0, with 59 present or not voting; Luttrell voted yes.

name: Shinji Oh
subject: Laws going into effect today!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Freedom Virginia, Inc
body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
As of today, July 1st, laws passed out of the General Assembly will go into effect. Five bills from our 2024 Affordability Scorecard [https://freedomva.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/2024-Freedom-Virginia-Affordability-Scorecard.pdf] will go into effect today!
Pharmacy Benefit Manager Transparency: SB660 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb660] and HB1402 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb1402]
*
This
law
will
increase
reporting
requirements
to
shed
light
on
the
rebates
and
fees
collected
by
Pharmacy
Benefit
Managers,
or
“PBMs,”
and
strengthen
enforcement
provisions
that
keep
this
information
hidden.
PBMs
directly
shape
costs
and
access
to
medications,
but
consumers
have
very
little
access
to
information
about
their
business
dealings.
This
won’t
change
existing
industry
practice—it
simply
requires
increased
data
transparency,
which
is
necessary
to
ensure
fair
costs
to
consumers.
Public Utility Shut-off Protection: SB480 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb480] and HB906 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb906]
*
This
law
will
prevent
electric,
gas,
water,
and
wastewater
utilities
from
disconnecting
residential
customers
from
service
on
Fridays,
weekends,
state
holidays,
and
the
day
immediately
preceding
a
state
holiday.
It
also
requires
each
utility
to
notify
its
residential
customers
of
the
disconnection
policy
and
to
deliver
notice
of
nonpayment
to
such
customers
before
disconnection.
Nonpayment
of
utility
bills
should
not
lead
to
a
life-or-death
situation.
Early Childhood and Education Fund: SB54 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb54] and HB419 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb419]
*
This
law
establishes
the
Early
Childhood
and
Education
Fund.
Additionally,
it
requires
the
Department
of
Education
to
report
annually
and
project
funding
needed
for
the
upcoming
two
fiscal
years
to
maintain
the
current
number
of
slots
and
increase
them
to
meet
parent
demand
at
early
childcare
and
education
sites.
Eligibility for the Child Care Subsidy Program: HB407 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb407]
*
The
Child
Care
Subsidy
Program
aims
to
empower
parents
or
caregivers
to
work,
search
for
work,
or
participate
in
education
and
training.
This
law
ensures
that
any
family
receiving
public
assistance
from
Medicaid
or
the
Special
Supplemental
Nutrition
Program
for
Women,
Infants,
and
Children
will
qualify
for
assistance
through
the
Child
Care
Subsidy
Program
to
help
them
pay
for
child

clean_body: freedomva.org [freedomva.org] Friends- As of today, July 1st, laws passed out of the General Assembly will go into effect. Five bills from our 2024 Affordability Scorecard [] will go into effect today! Pharmacy Benefit Manager Transparency: SB660 [] and HB1402 [] This law will increase reporting requirements to shed light on the rebates and fees collected by Pharmacy Benefit Managers, or “PBMs,” and strengthen enforcement provisions that keep this information hidden. PBMs directly shape costs and access to medications, but consumers have very little access to information about their business dealings. This won’t change existing industry practice—it simply requires increased data transparency, which is necessary to ensure fair costs to consumers. Public Utility Shut-off Protection: SB480 [] and HB906 [] This law will prevent electric, gas, water, and wastewater utilities from disconnecting residential customers from service on Fridays, weekends, state holidays, and the day immediately preceding a state holiday. It also requires each utility to notify its residential customers of the disconnection policy and to deliver notice of nonpayment to such customers before disconnection. Nonpayment of utility bills should not lead to a life-or-death situation. Early Childhood and Education Fund: SB54 [] and HB419 [] This law establishes the Early Childhood and Education Fund. Additionally, it requires the Department of Education to report annually and project funding needed for the upcoming two fiscal years to maintain the current number of slots and increase them to meet parent demand at early childcare and education sites. Eligibility for the Child Care Subsidy Program: HB407 [] The Child Care Subsidy Program aims to empower parents or caregivers to work, search for work, or participate in education and training. This law ensures that any family receiving public assistance from Medicaid or the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children will qualify for assistance through the Child Care Subsidy Program to help them pay for child care. This simply amends the current code to include these families. Payment Parameters for the Commonwealth Health Reinsurance Program: HB591 [] * The Commonwealth Health Reinsurance Program aims to reduce health insurance costs by reimbursing insurance carriers for a portion of their high-cost claims. This law requires the State Corporation Commission, the body that regulates insurance, utilities, and businesses in Virginia, to set payment parameters that achieve the premium reduction target in the Commonwealth Health Reinsurance Program, which subsidizes plans sold on Virginia’s new health exchange. Thank you for your support of these issues during the General Assembly session. We hope you’re just as excited as we are to see these laws go into effect! name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zao2rd2bvf357p4q6m4k8c5bvmpdbpeh7ur45a18_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3im4pj0c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zobgghai2ebkc7koptdsopn610ijssk3u3adu600_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3im4pj0c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9aj86i7t80uf0hm2kmdikqa1qtfgb0l45bb305g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3im4pj0c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3khd3log80lo4tjdtj3293hvqgrpk4dfohqa6fo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3im4pj0c3h2bs)**

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.libertyledger._ylCOuDA)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.libertyledger._S-aL0tIOsIBA)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.libertyledger.-LryBmhw)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose

Hello, in just a minute I’ll ask you to split a contribution between my campaign and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell's ahead of our critical midnight deadline, but first I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why it’s so important to give — especially today.
I grew up on my family’s farm, and Sharla and I still work that land today. In my opinion, being a farmer makes me a better senator. My background is a big part of the reason I remain grounded and focused on defending our Montana way of life. Because with all the chaos in Washington (especially now), you need somebody who will roll up their sleeves and get to work.
Last time I ran, nearly $70 million was spent on the Montana Senate race. This time around, we’ve already passed that number: **A****n eye-popping $120 million has been spent or reserved in advertising alone.** It’ll take a lot of support from this team to raise what we’ll need to protect this seat.
And if you know me, I’m not the kind of person who likes to ask for money. But I bet Mitch McConnell would be _furious_ if we showed him that a whole lot of grassroots power is stronger than his wealthy donors and super PACs will ever be.
Let’s be clear: **This election isn’t a sure thing.** Experts say this race is a toss-up and rank Montana as one of the seats most likely to flip. That’s why it’s SO important you make a contribution today — everything is on the line.
Everyone — including Mitch McConnell — is watching what we raise to judge the strength of this team. **I don’t expect you to chip in every time I ask, but I need you on my side now more than ever to show our opponents we’re ready to fight back and win.**

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkfc15uvb03b55d654su3j78cr1qakglot916ur0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zactlbodvvmfbimh00ns5hb09t89k18jbbmk38so_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi7t0fmcaogmrj0mbhgqoh0qt950h045sgk965c8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, friend?
While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country.**** And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**

subject: Will you help me defend women against the left’s gender insanity?
body:
And I will not shut up
| Peter, You may have heard my story. I’m the swimmer from the University of Kentucky who was forced to compete against a man at the women’s NCAA championships.
But I’m not speaking out because of what happened to me. Rather, I’m speaking louder because there are thousands of young women and girls who are told they need to “shut up.” They’re told men deserve women’s trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women’s locker rooms. **Well, I disagree. And I will not shut up.** [I won’t sit by and let other women and girls have their accomplishments erased and their safety put at risk. ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=19d46ed1292347e49714143d0fcdcc48&_e=Z2z0dD8KgtsspcUSLoblYKB-zCmJJ0iKxZUxUQgU10pnhTkC9JugWqDyxqKcTcKgsJkwY_vTxBhIZ4_awnD-nxxY-nLgzX0jNmql4DeZFLhfLeWpejzsB-UGXC8w_kpHtbCDXC2gvhKJw3Mo0F_YHtIDXx96KMo3klOUX0II725hAWENvVKIH5M5eKh3PVlJHIGo4eFgvivpX6Uz-wcgZnOpx5tg2gDW3oSfVAdGUl2BpYYKDbING_Yes_QVWxtwB3e9RShivjuqp2JPQD8qTByhgTGkxEo_Ulja6saghtAGoWpDdkwKBbKzD-HOUwMlCyIVjx7OaN1kU9vvI6q8Wuer6AfAENnxnfQp_cTPut88_Kjwq_PSSw-Fyx4XUUzvCEbtW3W9NrZRfje8H5HtYcpLZhmQtvC2HikCsbF7ApwV-KNezYl83-JF7yIQNZm07eCjGiFc9CsteZIIrTlDyL1Ec387lw_qn_mY0lVikg3AMPLdlc1IKSxkTk1aMB-jaim5kGaxdTl-7kZSnxV40g%3D%3D) I joined the **Leadership Institute** to educate, activate, and mobilize thousands of young women and men to fight for their rights. The Leadership Institute organized and funded my speaking tour on college campuses all over the country. My colleagues and I start conversations, recruit ambassadors, and help others make a big difference in their communities. My team at the Leadership Institute and I plan to go back on the road this fall, speaking out across the country. clean_body: And I will not shut up | Peter, You may have heard my story. I’m the swimmer from the University of Kentucky who was forced to compete against a man at the women’s NCAA championships. But I’m not speaking out because of what happened to me. Rather, I’m speaking louder because there are thousands of young women and girls who are told they need to “shut up.” They’re told men deserve women’s trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women’s locker rooms. Well, I disagree. And I will not shut up. I joined the Leadership Institute to educate, activate, and mobilize thousands of young women and men to fight for their rights. The Leadership Institute organized and funded my speaking tour on college campuses all over the country. My colleagues and I start conversations, recruit ambassadors, and help others make a big difference in their communities. My team at the Leadership Institute and I plan to go back on the road this fall, speaking out across the country. If you donate at least $100 you will get a copy of my new book! name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z977pbrg28glu4f2l04fe10c0ckpseo2rv5tu0vg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8mo4g0nmu3lh90bcvv4p98v387j79qlho5i9rk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7vuknt3dmbthnomjs3e8q0f2mnaofavs1nsdb6o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3m84c7c8ai8t9d2skvolo1versskfhjci4depeo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s3imao30c3h2bs)**

| [](http://trk.secureandprosper.-BvV9bKA) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. subject: Good news for PA businesses
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voice of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

The segment focused on proposed net operating loss (NOL) reform aiming to foster economic growth and attract new businesses to PA.

Luke Bernstein of the PA Chamber joined us to share his views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **PA Chamber of Business & Industry President & CEO Luke Bernstein** explains that NOLs occur when a business spends more than it makes in a year. A higher NOL cap allows startups to use these losses to reduce future taxes, providing financial relief and greater ability to grow. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b50e67ccea&e=b7b3eddce2)]

Bernstein recounts **PA's lost multi-billion dollar opportunity with U.S. Steel** due to the state's harsh regulatory environment. "Arkansas cut the ribbon before they even got the permit passed in PA.” [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2b1d536df7&e=b7b3eddce2)]

"Forget North Carolina's 'research triangle' – **PA has a research rectangle**." PA's business leaders want the bright, young entrepreneurs at our world-class universities to start and grow their businesses here. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=936fff7dd8&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _National Comparison_
* Twenty-five states have no NOL cap, nineteen states match the federal cap of 80%, four states have no CNI, and only two states—Pennsylvania and New Hampshire—have an NOL cap under 80%, **ranking them "dead last" in the nation**. [[PA Chamber](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6a9cfd63d5&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Demographics_
* PA has lost a congressional seat in each of the last ten censuses, **dropping from over thirty seats to just seventeen** – due to population loss driven by PA's strict business regulations. [[PA Chamber](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8dfdde5a0b&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Policy_
* Sen. Rothman's proposed bill would gradually **raise PA's NOL by 10% each year, eventually locking in at an 80% cap**, allowing PA to be competitive with nineteen other states. [[PA Chamber](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=019763bf0e&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **PA imposes a “startup penalty” on businesses – NOL reform changes that**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4cb9ee0d98&e=b7b3eddce2 "Top Policy Proposals to Watch in PA’s Budget Battle | Voices of Reason Ep. 7")
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It**
---
| PoliticsPA was **live on-site at the Harrisburg rotunda** earlier this week recording our signature podcast, _Voices of Reason_.

_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=59b7449659&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1835a73d4c&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a4b8f223fb&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7ecebd721b&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b20816afe4&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6b91f32090&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

| | Dear Reader,How about a newspaper that actually loves America?

I'm not just talking about good, old-fashioned flag-waving love of country. I'm talking about much more than that.

It's no secret that most of our national press is ideologically corrupt. It's steeped in agenda-driven coverage and champions grand schemes designed to weaken American ideals and influence on the world stage.

The New York Sun is cut from different cloth. It's a paper that lives and breathes American values. It has done since 1833.

We understand well what makes our country unique and why we must fight for it.

We're sworn to defend and uphold our national parchment, the Constitution of the United States.

We know that equality before the law must be applied in practice and not just in principle.

The Sun's famed 19th century editor, Charles A. Dana, put it this way: "An American who thinks another country is better than this should not go into journalism."

125 years later, we couldn't agree more.

With an election just months away, the stakes couldn't be higher.Today, I'm inviting you to join the paper that fights for the America we know and love. We need every citizen with us. We need YOU with us.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: THANK YOU for being a part of this team
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1606%2E135344%2ETwuN4U)

Team --
Last night at midnight was our official FEC filing deadline for the second quarter of 2024. I know we sent A LOT of fundraising requests to you before this deadline. And I know nobody loves that.
But it means that we will be able to file an official report with the FEC that I hope you will be proud of. Because there is only one way we are going to have the resources to defend this Senate seat, and that is from lots of people contributing what they can.
This deadline—the last one before the Republican convention in Milwaukee—was a big moment for our campaign. This race is shaping up to be one of the most competitive in the country, and one of only two open competitive Senate seats.
I don’t accept corporate PAC money (which usually come in multiple-thousand-dollar checks at a time) so this campaign really is funded by people like you, and I’m so proud of the support I’ve received so far. Because of you, we were able to get our ads up on TV early and start to share our positive message before our Republican opponents spend millions attacking me.
It’s hard to believe, but we have just four months until Election Day. I’m encouraged by our progress and excited to continue traveling the state to meet more voters. If we keep this up and continue to hit our goals, I’m confident that we can keep this Senate seat blue and achieve big things together.
No matter how you get involved, I’m so grateful that you’re a part of this team.
Thank you, again.
Elissa

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 4145
East Lansing, MI 48826
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=4&akid=1606%2E135344%2ETwuN4U).
