name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12699830?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

**This week, we will celebrate the 4th of July and the liberties and independence we have here in America**. As we spend time with family and friends over the next several days, let’s reflect on our nation’s rich history and remember to give thanks for the brave men and women who have paid the ultimate sacrifice to preserve our freedom.

In this week’s newsletter, I have some exciting updates to share with you. **In addition to spending a lot of time out in the community, I launched a[podcast](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=89db2d3a60&e=d1c1b9864f)!** This will be an opportunity for Floridians to learn more about the entrepreneurial principles at the heart of our great nation and how we can get America back on the right track. I hope you will give it a listen!

I consider it an honor to serve House District 24 in our state legislature. Thank you for trusting me to fight back against the insanity of the radical Left and get real things done for our community. **Please never hesitate to reach out to my office if you are in need of assistance.** We would be more than happy to help you in any way we can. Please contact us by clicking [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a5cbf3e65a&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
| | **Wednesday, June 26 - The Villages Salt & Light**
---
|
---
---
| I had the wonderful opportunity to speak to the members of **Salt and Light** while in **The Villages**. It was great to have a discussion on this past legislative session and the upcoming amendments we will vote on in November. I urge everyone to continue to educate themselves on these important issues. There is a lot at stake.
---
| | **Tuesday, June 25 - SECO Energy Meeting & Campaign Event for Republican Candidate Chad Johnson**
---
| [ ](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=8752ce1245&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| My incredible staff attended the **SECO Energy** meeting event on storm preparedness measures. The meeting revolved around their work to enhance public safety across **Central Florida**. Please find more information [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=63e6ec43e8&e=d1c1b9864f) if you have any questions regarding storm preparedness for your utilities companies or the **State of Florida**. You can also reach out to our office [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=4145cf5ccb&e=d1c1b9864f). We will get you connected with someone who can help.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Later that day, I had the opportunity to join fellow Florida leaders for a fundraising event for conservative candidate **Chad Johnson**. He is running to serve **House District 22** in our state legislature, which includes **Gilchrist** , **Levy** , and part of **Alachua** counties. I proudly support Chad in this race and look forward to working with him in Tallahassee to get things done for our communities.
---
| | **Rep. Ryan Chamberlin Launches ****The Constitutional Entrepreneur Podcast!**
---
|
---
| As I mentioned at the beginning of this newsletter, I officially launched my podcast, “**The Constitutional Entrepreneur**.” This project has been on my mind for several years, and I’m very excited to bring this to you. You can listen to my first episode on YouTube [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5fcea74779&e=d1c1b9864f). Please like and subscribe!

I believe our country was founded on Godly, entrepreneurial principles. The more we deviate from those principles, the more political problems we seem to have. Let’s influence this generation to move back towards them. I’m excited to share what I’ve learned and am still learning. I’m also excited to introduce you to other key influencers and what they have learned. We’re in this together!
---
| | **Freedom Month Sales Tax Holiday**
---
|
---
| Starting today, **July 1** , Floridians can save big on summer fun during the **Freedom Month Sales Tax Holiday**. Click [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cc374cb9ad&e=d1c1b9864f) to learn more about the qualifying recreation and outdoor items and admissions to entertainment and cultural events.
---

---

The Supreme Court MUST be reformed.
Peter,
Today the Trump-stacked MAGA majority on the U.S. Supreme Court granted Donald Trump partial immunity over his actions to overturn the 2020 election.
**It’s a stunning, unprecedented decision that puts our democracy on the chopping block. Here's why:**
We have a principle that no one is above the law. Justice Sotomayor explains in her dissent that this decision makes “a mockery” of this principle. **The Supreme Court is facing a full-blown legitimacy crisis.** It’s long past time for Congress to restore accountability and transparency in our judiciary. Congress must pass judicial ethics reform, expand and rebalance the court, and hold this runaway Court accountable.

subject: Why is Gen Z so intolerant?
body:
It should surprise no one that Gen Z has a shallow and selective idea about “tolerance.”

|

| | [](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0LHOpCAUBeCnwU5zARUtKDYxdrPFNlsSBu_o3QgYRP64T7-ZZLb_2y8nJznn98M8LO0U1p_Wo07epNPEI5u71F_bXa8Y6r9GgGhrUDVww6tF96NQA69Qc8XHQYEcebVpp8Zn--p4pxxiC-1ToRhGUALgNY6dqki_e0ABFxxAdk039ID21SJYEICctZDwuJ47ORu8_RMT5bsJmKtdbzkfJ5M_mJiZmO94hbVEcng2CUtpXGRiPmy9xGAzMjlf2Rtn_WFpDUxOtkRaKKymkMvktxgXJvp3yONCl2dySljOzSb8-Bmv5JDJ6bAfyY7J6dej_r_iwy6GjCEzOe1xjVXSy_FF-05nr1gLq7e0Ny76Kn_r3aLFvwAAAP__G7KB-A)
Friend,

It should surprise no one that Gen Z has a shallow and selective idea about “tolerance.”

Why would I say that? For starters, 90% of Gen Z expressed support for the Black Lives Matter movement, and less than 50% believe there are “just two genders.”

While progressives praise these statistics as surefire indicators of “tolerance,” _Gen Z has shown a rapidly increasing rate of intolerance for people of different viewpoints_. [](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0DGPnDAQBeBfYzrQ2AYMBUUktN2mSJPSmjOzMBG2kTE-kV8fnbTpr_309KT3fj_tE3nnsP5ET1PyNp02Htnepf7c7nqlUP-1ClRbg6lBWlktUz8qM8iKJmnkOBjQo6y2aRi7l4FOGkmjWwxB92FAUvdqiYZeYcXTVw8YkEoC6K7phh4IXy0BggKSooVEx_Wxs8Pg8U9MnO8mUK72acv5OIX-IdRDqMcdr7CWyI7OJlEpjYtCPQ6slxgwk9CPK3vr0B_IaxB6xhJ54bDawi6z32JchOq_Qp4WvrzQc6Jybpjo7We8kiOh5wPfkp3Q869n_X_Fm10MmUIWemaPK1VpWo5P3nc-eyNaWD3y3rjoq_yte8uk_gUAAP__Al6Cpg)
This includes the belief in meritocracy and the American Dream.

**While these values were once universally understood by Americans, they have now become counter-cultural.** It’s no wonder they are the most anxious, alienated, and depressed generation in history.

There are young people who aren’t afraid to stand against the Marxism that has taken over Gen Z and speak up for values like freedom of speech and tolerance, but they lack a platform to make their views known.

**That’s where Young Voices comes in.**

I’m Lexi Boccuzzi, a contributor with Young Voices. They give young speakers and writers like me a platform to help us speak out against the growing rate of harassment and violence among Gen Z and protect free speech.

[You can help Young Voices train and platform more life-long advocates for freedom like me by donating today. Please click below to show your support.](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0DGP3CAUBOBfgztbD_AaXFBEsrbbFGlSIha_s19iwMKYi_Pro5U2_bWfRiPN_HzYh6ON4vLdBTQ52HzYtBd71fZzvdoFY_vXChB9C6oFbnkzm2EUSvMGDVd81ArkyJvVOA6jB_Ucnx_zTQstuJZa9sOobqi9Fw2ZVw8o4IIDyFt30wOg--gRHAhAznrIuJ_PjbyLwf1KmcrVRSzNZtZS9oPJb0zcmbhf6YxLTeTx6DLW2vnExH137ZyiK8jk_SzBehd2R0tkcnI10UxxsZV8obCmNDMxvEIBZzoDk1PGeqwu49uPdGaPTE67e0vxTE4_Hu3_FW_2KRaMhcmp4J9iN4q_eZPNvH_SttExKNbDEhxtnU-hKV_6uBrxLwAA__89QIRG)
[Donate](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0D9vhSAUBfBPg5uGPyoyMDQxbq9Dl44E4T6lETCIvNhP37z0de_6y809Oefzpm7abS4s79qDTF6lQ8U9q6vUj_WqFwj1t6KYtjXmNSaKVFb2gvKBVCAJJ2LgmAlSrRIY2E7A3M0M5rvAFKyhfBACuLgb3VZOPv9gjgklGLOu6YYeg763gDWmGAhqcYL9nDdndPD6KyaXryZArja55rwfiL0hOiE6XfEMS4nOwNEkKKUxEdFp17WNQWdAbDqzV0b7XbslIDbqEp11YVHFmez8GqNFtH8eebDu9IiNCcqx6gQvP-KZDCA27vol2SA2ftzqvxYvNjFkCBmx8TdczWfOMVRJ2v3hts0dPUctXrx2W2Oir_K_Zi6S_gQAAP__oMiHEw)
It should be unsurprising that antisemitism would take such a fierce hold among today’s youth. It is inconsistent with the Jewish heritage to play the victim.

A worldview centered around tradition, community, success, and, most importantly, survival against all odds represents everything this generation lacks. It is no surprise that the illiberal progressive ideologies that have captivated Gen Z would draw a target on the nation that refuses to be victimized.

**As a Catholic, I was also raised with a sense of personal accountability for my actions. This is how we can experience both real liberty and moral fulfillment.**

But theirs is a different, more pervasive kind of ideology fueled by jealousy. These are America’s best and brightest – but they are filled with hatred and ripe for radicalization.

At Young Voices, we're fostering a community where freethinkers and free opinion thrive in the face of leftist intolerance and victimhood.

**Your generous support helps give a voice to brave young journalists who stand up for American principles like free speech and personal accountability.**

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3439%2E552475%2EuZXjV7)
Peter, I want to be clear: David McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania.
[**Before I explain why, can you chip in $5 or more to help keep PA and the Senate blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240701-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240701-2&refcode2=3439_552475_uZXjV7&akid=3439%2E552475%2EuZXjV7)

David McCormick is a hedge fund executive from Connecticut who got rich selling out our workers and working families.
He may say he will fight for Pennsylvania’s working families, but the truth is he spent his career selling out working people, investing in foreign adversaries at our expense, and shipping American jobs overseas.
If David McCormick is going to be a fighter for Pennsylvania’s working families, then I’m the starting quarterback for the Eagles.
The bottom line is Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator who will fight for them.
Still, we’re up against David McCormick’s millions and his billionaire backers, which is why this is the toughest race I’ve faced yet. A super PAC supporting McCormick is launching a $30 million ad buy to flip this seat red. That’s why your support today is mission-critical.

body:
This is not good.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88070754/483020524/1328794144?refcode=ea.2685c1d5-ef37-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2685c1d5-ef37-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI2ODVjMWQ1LWVmMzctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=p__B5eO-Y2rZ6q1zQy-KxOFO17p6pdYXwbVSUpbV664=&emci=23ec6214-e437-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2685c1d5-ef37-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
Today’s Supreme Court decision is nothing short of shocking: Donald Trump now has presumed immunity from federal prosecution for his official actions during his presidency. This marks the _first time_ SCOTUS has recognized any form of presidential immunity from prosecution. This ruling means that the far-right Supreme Court has given up its constitutional duty as a check and balance on the executive branch, a move that threatens to undermine the stability of our federal system. And let’s be clear: This is a brazen attempt to aid Donald Trump’s subversion of our democracy. | [**FIGHT BACK**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88070755/483020525/2105508926?refcode=ea.2685c1d5-ef37-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.2685c1d5-ef37-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI2ODVjMWQ1LWVmMzctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=p__B5eO-Y2rZ6q1zQy-KxOFO17p6pdYXwbVSUpbV664=)
---
_But what does this mean for the climate fight?_
The Court just gave Donald Trump the go-ahead to use the office of the presidency for his own gain if he’s re-elected in November.
**We can bet that’ll give Big Oil CEOs and other corporate interests unfettered access to line presidential pockets and undo all the progress we’ve made stopping them.**
Trump’s ties to Big Oil and his willingness to sell out our environment are no secret. He’s already been caught soliciting a billion-dollar bribe from fossil fuel executives in exchange for gutting hard-won environmental protections — from progress on electric vehicles and wind energy to giving the industry more offshore drilling leases and relaxing regulations.
Now, with the Supreme Court’s blessing, he’ll be able to engage in corrupt dealings with little fear of being held accountable if he retakes the White House.
If we don’t take action, Trump and his Big Oil allies will steamroll over the progress we've made in fighting the climate crisis.
This ruling makes it clear: We must organize, mobilize, and fight back harder than ever before. **We need to build a firewall of pro-climate champions in state and local elected officials across the country. We MUST stop Trump and derail his dirty deals before it’s too late. Our future depends on it.**

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1607%2E135344%2EvG-0H2)

Friend -
The Supreme Court just expanded presidential power in a ruling along partisan lines which states that presidents are immune from criminal prosecution over “official acts,” a category which the Court appears to define broadly.
The Court’s decision makes it likely that the trial over Trump’s acts on and leading up to January 6th will be postponed until after the election. A district court will now rule on whether his actions constitute official acts, and legal scholars believe that the Court’s definition of official acts will likely result in at least some charges being dropped. It makes me think about another moment in our history, where a different President tried to use the office to protect himself and his power.
Fifty years ago, the Supreme Court unanimously ordered President Richard Nixon to turn over tapes to the Watergate special prosecutor. The Court, which included several Nixon appointees, ruled swiftly and firmly on a principle that should be obvious: nobody is above the law, much less those that we entrust with our trust and the great powers of the presidency.
Today, the Court has abandoned that tradition of putting country over partisanship and set a dangerous precedent that will enable future presidents—perhaps even Trump himself—to commit crimes without fear of accountability.
We fought a revolution to escape an unaccountable King. This ruling creates a system like the one the founders fought to abolish and harms the constitutional order that they created. Justice Sotomayor offered a clear warning on the effects of this ruling, writing, “with fear for our democracy, I dissent.”
This ruling raises the stakes immeasurably for the November election. The first Trump presidency brought us to the brink of a constitutional crisis, culminating in his attempts to overturn the 2020 election and January 6th. As someone who was in the Capitol on that day, I shudder to think about Trump unleashed with the protection of the Supreme Court against criminal prosecution.
Here’s the key to preventing that outcome: win in Michigan. If Trump wins here, he’s almost certainly the next President of the United States.
We have built the kind of grassroots campaign that will bring out Democrats from every area of Michigan to win this race, and hopefully help ensure Donald Trump is defeated as well.
[**But no matter our success so far, there are still many undecided voters we have to reach. That’s why I’m asking: will you consider chipping in $3 to help us keep Michigan blue?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240701-2-400&t=2&akid=1607%2E135344%2EvG-0H2)

body:
Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from my
colleague Tim Kaine. Tim is running for reelection in Virginia to defend
our Democratic Senate majority, so I hope you'll read his update and
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-kaine.wCcz8-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]chip in if you can.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Folks, the primary results are in and I have some important updates to
share. But before I get into that, I have to ask: [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3901?c0=tbe-em-kaine.AMj9j2&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]Will you become a
General Election Founding Donor of my re-election campaign by splitting a
$30 donation between me and Tammy Baldwin right now? This is going to be a
tough fight, and I need you by my side.

I want to start by sharing how profoundly grateful I am to officially be
your Democratic nominee for the United States Senate. I’ve been serving
the Commonwealth for my entire adult life — in my career as a civil rights
lawyer, on Richmond City Council, as Mayor of Richmond, as Lieutenant
Governor and Governor of Virginia, and now as U.S. Senator — and my
passion for this work only grows with each year. Thank you for everything
you’ve done to support me over the years and during this election cycle,
which will be the most consequential in our lifetime. We can only make
progress by working together, so it means the world to me to have you on
this team.

Now, let’s talk about my opponent.

Virginia Republicans have nominated Hung Cao to run against me. Cao is a
MAGA extremist through and through:

* He’s endorsed by Donald Trump.
* He would be an automatic vote for a national abortion ban, and wants
to dismantle the Affordable Care Act and put Social Security and
Medicare on the chopping block.
* He wants to release and even seek compensation for convicted January
6th insurrectionists.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-kaine.wCcz8-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]Hung Cao and Donald Trump

Cao isn’t new to Virginia politics — in 2022, he ran against my friend
Jennifer Wexton in VA’s 10th Congressional District and proved himself as
a strong grassroots fundraiser, bringing in millions of dollars even as
other Republican candidates, often with more national support, struggled
to do the same.

This time around, Cao won’t be hurting for national support. He’s Trump’s
hand-picked candidate, and you can bet that the rest of the GOP will be
right behind him funneling millions of dollars to Virginia in the push to
unseat me.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-kaine.wCcz8-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]We cannot afford to get complacent with a candidate like Hung Cao on
the ballot, so I’m asking you to split a donation between me and Tammy
Baldwin right now to become a General Election Founding Donor of my
re-election campaign.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Tim Kaine and Tammy Baldwin will go through immediately:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2151?c0=tbe-em-kaine.J4SPaA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]SPLIT $10 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2152?c0=tbe-em-kaine.x1wfhJ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]SPLIT $25 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2153?c0=tbe-em-kaine.8h9rOo&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]SPLIT $50 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2154?c0=tbe-em-kaine.lHjuDO&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1010&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]SPLIT $100 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2158?c0=tbe-em-kaine.4k2NYm&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1011&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]SPLIT $250 NOW

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-kaine.wCcz8-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1012&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

Look, I’m running for re-election because I love Virginia. I love the
people of this Commonwealth, from Abingdon to Arlington and everywhere in
between, and I believe in us.

In the face of a Republican party that’s hellbent on tearing down our
rights and even our very democracy, I believe we are and will continue to
be stand-up people. We stand up for what’s right, for economic
opportunity, for democracy and equality, and for each other.

I am determined to win re-election this year in part because my opponent
has made it clear that he is not a stand-up leader. It’s clear even from
how he operates on the campaign trail — refusing to attend a candidate
forum in Abingdon because he deemed it “ridonkulous” to drive there from
his home in Northern Virginia and ridiculing the Staunton newspaper as
“podunk”?? That’s not the leadership our Commonwealth deserves.

Right now, I need your support to defeat my extremist opponent and keep my
seat in the Senate — because we’ve got a lot more work left to do in this
fight to stand up for each other.

Will you become a General Election Founding Donor? You can contribute to
me and Tammy Baldwin at this link:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-kaine.wCcz8-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240701_PM1_V1_S1&t=1013&akid=2935%2E35263%2E2EgAPX ]secure.actblue.com/donate/tbe-em-kaine

Thank you so much — from the bottom of my heart.

Now let’s go win this!

-Tim Kaine

body:
It's time for Congress to re-learn how to write real laws.

| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=6c675e44291b4e64af1f55bd1d6265c5&_e=eNEO0nRGoarLGTaA723g7HZaesafeMbQpFeTxvccUiOuU1ufFGa6IV2eNiKuy0AU4W7g7Czuz3zaoKe3YX0HbSKJHgxRbNl4Pm0Zv12bwytIiQJd3yplu2Gdi3t0ztz-YtIQ4AENlm7tw-6dSwf8BMCglaaJgc6N17mGEGf8S63NLcAMf44IZWqRKDeT3h8QXiT3_tkInt4Q854vG-o9Qg_zV1kPzUVDkRyRRb6ypEkF8QJYqE25dGqJm0gA3te_mAAYVN6KY7oYsyn3Daw88HzUb53E2kDjZijlbjNCp1tJEtu02wWp0HXG-8M5g2U9e0IJD4sInwyFxYp3VG4aUVUxcPecCUaIs-RWAgXSoY8%3D)
---
Friend,

Today the Supreme Court overruled the Chevron doctrine. This is a BIG WIN against big government.

The Chevron doctrine – under which federal courts more-or-less blindly deferred to a federal agency's interpretation of a law that the agency is charged with administering – hurt "the little guy" and helped "the big guy," as Justice Gorsuch suggested.

But it was much worse than that.

Administrative lawmaking as a whole excluded the people from the process—all in the name of "letting the experts work out the details."

Hardworking Americans can vote against lawmakers they don't like.

But – unlike big corporations – they have no effective means at their disposal to influence federal agencies.

Consequently, the voices of the rich and powerful were heard, while all others were silenced.

Congress needs to give the American people a seat at the table again by passing the REINS Act, which would require all "major rule" regulations to be passed into law by Congress before taking effect.

The REINS Act would include the American people in the lawmaking process, and that's something the Constitution already requires – albeit in ways that Congress and the courts have been ignoring for decades.

The REINS Act would fix that problem. **[It's time to pass it.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=6c675e44291b4e64af1f55bd1d6265c5&_e=eNEO0nRGoarLGTaA723g7HZaesafeMbQpFeTxvccUiOuU1ufFGa6IV2eNiKuy0AU4W7g7Czuz3zaoKe3YX0HbSKJHgxRbNl4Pm0Zv12bwytIiQJd3yplu2Gdi3t0ztz-YtIQ4AENlm7tw-6dSwf8BMCglaaJgc6N17mGEGf8S63NLcAMf44IZWqRKDeT3h8QXiT3_tkInt4Q854vG-o9Qh71HaXd_d05_gUQjIoap6XPaRJD8B_30VW2Qnbsp-tGG8QHr91JBOdaZRQQ-y7P3f16MVH8Yn7N0UxiV6YnHuojs9apVBqS0ETjf5TetnvW3Rfm2gF6vndpY_PV3U7l4TDX2ZwnEaZ_ex6Pk_vXFx0%3D) **

Peter, Yesterday I sent you the below email with important news which you may have missed it. It is a very critical update so I am sending it to you again. _**First, the great, amazing, awesome news:**_ Our long awaited matching funds have been approved! In fact, the FEC wrote to request banking information to start transferring the first payment. WooHOO!! **But here's the catch.** Just after emailing that our matching funds would soon be on the way, the FEC oddly sent a second email claiming **no payments could be made until August, after the nominating conventions.** (This is allegedly to allow the FEC to determine whether candidates will apply for matching funds for the general election.) Our attorney is on the case. No mention was made of such a rule in our two previous campaigns that qualified for primary matching funds. So perhaps this is a bureaucratic error we can expeditiously correct. But in the meantime, **this leaves us high and dry** for hundreds of thousands of dollars already owed for petition drives. And, we must raise hundreds of thousands more in July to complete our ballot drives. In other words, we need your support now so we can continue the ballot drives -- while we fight for the funds we've been promised. Without an immediate major boost, we're at a standstill and will miss many imminent petition deadlines. Friend, Republican billionaire donors just bought an election to unseat Rep. Jamaal Bowman, spending $20 million against him in the most expensive House primary in U.S. history. No wonder the billionaire class wanted to get Jamaal out of office—he led multiple bills to make corporations, billionaires, and ultra-millionaires pay their fair share in taxes. Meanwhile, his opponent is not only pro-genocide, but also against raising taxes on the wealthy. **To limit billionaires’ political power, we need to fight even harder for legislation like the**** _Billionaire Minimum Income Tax_** , which**** would ensure that every household worth over $100 million is paying an effective tax rate of at least 25% on their full income each year—including all their gains on investments, most of which now goes untaxed. **A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=25be184e4ecb4616a19511ba4f509182&_e=XTN8rQSRlhWEMTE9Yhp26oLgesaavSGGMpn0ylDt989onfEh-ZDqTU8q5gwM6QTj6QY4sCvuA-ZW52pvx3JmA-iepMxXHpYtRiQpcZkSOCRW4hlTjwQXu0dNGK-IFeLzxgSo06w9rudLL2UuKhKjggDQizKjwJZXT_qZzhYuyIOv4pOOy3KcHn7e_bDBGBtRfzx6ndMmPQiCZnoii9QGJn3vORhjXFoATc2bfefICbBNVVuNQHGBtZU4tj3Mz5NGJqTok0nF_kyFoffJFcVwhA%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=25be184e4ecb4616a19511ba4f509182&_e=XTN8rQSRlhWEMTE9Yhp26oLgesaavSGGMpn0ylDt989onfEh-ZDqTU8q5gwM6QTj6QY4sCvuA-ZW52pvx3JmA-iepMxXHpYtRiQpcZkSOCRW4hlTjwQXu0dNGK-IFeLzC8A7UV_9FR_hgzZwbGoPSftm_Gyl-DEHr-axkFjhDlEFGTkm_kbyoRVfpCTQnzb_NrsNaCsg5E7RXZx6FcqNuzC9mlDG_cLFsOOxQpHt95yXbAWaG8e_HjklP3tRYkUcUiNSMqeeku49BOHW-m68nA%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=25be184e4ecb4616a19511ba4f509182&_e=XTN8rQSRlhWEMTE9Yhp26oLgesaavSGGMpn0ylDt989onfEh-ZDqTU8q5gwM6QTj6QY4sCvuA-ZW52pvx3JmA-iepMxXHpYtRiQpcZkSOCRW4hlTjwQXu0dNGK-IFeLz8-aMUFiXaePefUf0_IZP-1cPLjGDtyHhFzOs818UTR_Rl-0QiZhxupVDMmOiL9iuwLsBWBTz8B3lsNeiHFdqdIDPWA77lrkFwRLP4846UF_ftO9f6Eg6YKCJ7GlEZeT47zn0nzt36rngCVQDCuj4Sg%3D%3D)

| | | | BREAKING — the MAGA Justices on the captured Supreme Court gave themselves even more power to block common-sense safeguards for the air we breathe and the water we drink.
---
| | _**This decision is earth-shattering. What happens next will depend on folks like you, Peter**_. The environmental movement needs all hands on deck in order to rally policymakers urgently to protect our communities and our climate.
---
| | We need to raise $40,000 to power our campaign. Because this goal is so important, **we just got approval to extend our Summer Membership Drive deadline and 3x match offer. **

---
| | The Court’s ruling in _Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo_ and _Relentless v. Department of Commerce_ overturns _Chevron v. NRDC_ , one of the most important cases you may never have heard of. In 1984, the landmark _Chevron_ case set the **precedent that courts should defer to experts at public agencies** in cases where the laws they are charged with implementing are unclear. It has been cited in court decisions more than 18,000 times — more than _Brown v. Board of Education_ or _Roe v. Wade_.
---
| | Big Oil and far-right extremists have been attacking the _Chevron_ doctrine because they want decisions about our rights and our environment to be made by MAGA judges they have bought, not the experts at the public agencies that protect the people. **Billionaires and corporations have showered MAGA Justices on the Supreme Court with luxury gifts and travel, and the lawyers who brought this case are backed by oil billionaire Charles Koch**. Today, their investments paid off. Big Oil and other corporations are positioned to make more money, and the people’s health and safety will suffer.
---
| | By overturning _Chevron_ , the Court is once again poised to undercut the EPA’s authority to rein in polluters and to protect our communities from dirty air and water, as well as the authority of public interest agencies that protect workers’ rights, students’ rights, patients’ rights, civil rights, and so much more. **In short, the MAGA Justices are trying to seize power from the people and the experts who know how to protect our communities, and take that power for themselves, their fellow MAGA judges, and the billionaires who pay for their vacations.**
---
| | We’re demanding that Congress act to rein in the corrupt MAGA Justices and ensure that the EPA has adequate resources and reaffirmed authority to protect our right to breathe clean air and drink clean water. [**_Whether our campaign succeeds will depend on people like you — please, renew your LCV membership while your support goes 3X as far. Even $5 makes an impact >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Pwb7C3a-)

Derek,
**Donald Trump attacked Bob Casey by name at a MAGA rally in Philadelphia saying that Pennsylvania “needs to defeat” Bob Casey.**
The GOP is rallying MAGA supporters in PA to flip this battleground red and elect a Connecticut jagoff. ❌
**[We cannot let this slide, Derek. Will you join me in rushing an emergency contribution right away to power Team Casey’s efforts to keep PA, the Senate, and the White House blue?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240701?refcode=em20240701-9177&refcode2=9177_434096_CDp5kP&akid=9177%2E434096%2ECDp5kP)**

The stakes have never been higher. The GOP wants to pass a national abortion ban and continue to strip away more and more rights with a stronger Supreme Court majority. 🤡
If we’re going to protect women’s rights, workers’ rights, and the fate of our democracy, we have to defend this battleground Senate race. **Your contribution right now will go directly into Bob Casey’s battleground campaign and power our first line of defense against MAGA Republicans.**

**Let’s keep PA 🔵**
❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

**A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=064a0ce103244fb98b9c36c99380dcd3&_e=jhCl9G_-XAMBLi8q63ecrUXyKLhbytj0W1zeW7zuz1qzbCzBmayPpHfK9ip50tUToyIdpY-K1zyyvot_QVqgBc77A-9Po1Ih0J4wyeG1NkolMkbgWXPlFKqT4Ebhy9x6JuIhDeAd-hWt6AJurWU9J2KiXu8UpysCJ_a_eqJjE_DQw2jAweJTnVQXJQt6FswS7ZYBZk0BkuyZXaVG1M0poA7lUb-ovrqj-ycj9c9dMtvqGGcq3Cb-T83CAxzXyFraqDtel7XDoAnaNxstZSRFqg%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=064a0ce103244fb98b9c36c99380dcd3&_e=jhCl9G_-XAMBLi8q63ecrUXyKLhbytj0W1zeW7zuz1qzbCzBmayPpHfK9ip50tUToyIdpY-K1zyyvot_QVqgBc77A-9Po1Ih0J4wyeG1NkolMkbgWXPlFKqT4Ebhy9x6CH1wlRfXRlReFN2Tyx4F0y4DRQamLdEoaKfGrSqughzNXJb984dBE6zYJe5Tbx9rqkogTKf5mGg-QSykXOFCLxiviBcMK9FbfY4OsJgY96-NmtfgNTjHoFVSzr_1kMefOJsW59Y5uNl9R84dLhFVPg%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=064a0ce103244fb98b9c36c99380dcd3&_e=jhCl9G_-XAMBLi8q63ecrUXyKLhbytj0W1zeW7zuz1qzbCzBmayPpHfK9ip50tUToyIdpY-K1zyyvot_QVqgBc77A-9Po1Ih0J4wyeG1NkolMkbgWXPlFKqT4Ebhy9x6_6JNP_CcABNxK_COAAcLR8CDC2Nfy_FAO6Ih9tH0uCBQ7lPp92e-hexXPZ7LspfeUZniMlMlr-W_Kx3IpMu28cBFrp60Dei-nYyRg8ikn70vI9pj9Bt02aY5I9sKfMHo7QhdOcbLO29r7rUeP8teiA%3D%3D)

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty. From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming. Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as "Wyoming's doctor," but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. body:
#
**Last month** , it was revealed that the Supreme Court received nearly $5 million in luxury gifts — $4.2 million of which was gifted solely to Clarence Thomas by MAGA megadonors.1
**Just days ago** , SCOTUS severely restricted the regulatory powers of federal agencies by overturning a legal precedent known as ‘Chevron deference.’2
**And this morning** , SCOTUS ruled that Donald Trump has ‘absolute immunity’ from prosecution for crimes he committed while he was President of the United States.
**The Supreme Court is in a legitimacy crisis.**
**[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240701.cjMUrY&refcode=em20240701-6744-P_FND_CTR_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6744%2E2526796%2Ez8Xsty)**
**This Court is setting the stage for a Trump presidency above the law.** If Congress fails to hold them accountable, it sends a dangerous signal to the special interests trying to buy them off that their actions are fair game.
[This level of corruption is shocking by any standard of a functioning democracy. Will you make a $5 contribution today so that AOC can keep fighting to ensure no one — no matter how rich or powerful — is above the law?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240701.cjMUrY&refcode=em20240701-6744-P_FND_CTR_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6744%2E2526796%2Ez8Xsty)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240701.cjMUrY&refcode=em20240701-6744-P_FND_CTR_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6744%2E2526796%2Ez8Xsty)**
After the news of SCOTUS’ luxury gifts, Alexandria joined Ranking Member Jamie Raskin to announce legislation barring Justices from receiving gifts valued over $50. **We will keep you updated as more develops on the Supreme Court**.
Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for standing with our movement.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

---
| | You may have seen a video of a Chinese rocket [accidentally](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=adb324968f7b41c0b5e42fa583bb8489&_e=-c1tL54Xvf94zPpVy_H8lea91aMuHabnBPlTDepZwiiihSz39OcOfBytlHokWI5L_T0Pna7iEGjrWnfMCib6ud2sfAZGE1wPNC2WzztUpmLk2QOu56pX6aiJzFKCfb2w8iM1vbjl66RINkv6c8hS19Juxfzaq11vQbt8HfesBRd0NKRRrdS1NCcpeHkwVLf1EinPigJ6H0RcDVFjATpiJfcbBaKbeP3O_YLm18Lv84swIa4I8In7kLuOVvPYoRAB9njbrYu_IrWqV8WVT2InlqzhYd5k0Vrs5hM-ZvqEf6I%3D) launching itself before plunging back to earth and exploding. The test was supposed to be a test-fire and not leave the pad, but clearly it was not secured well enough. It would be easy to laugh at the failure, but it should give us all a moment of pause. Why? That rocket was a test flight for a private Chinese space company, Space Pioneer (or Beijing Tianbing Technology). Think of it as a Chinese version of SpaceX or Blue Origin. China’s private space industry is, pardon the pun, taking off and aims to outcompete American companies—including attempting to land and recover a rocket like SpaceX’s impressive Falcon 9—and enable the Chinese military’s space ambitions, ambitions that will see Beijing dominate space if we don’t prepare and plan accordingly.

clean_body: | Team, Today’s shameful Supreme Court decision — a decision that grants Trump immunity from criminal prosecution for “official acts” as President — was decided 6-3. Donald Trump’s very own appointed Supreme Court justices Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett ruled in favor of his attempts to evade any accountability for his blatantly corrupt and illegal actions, including his attempts to interfere with the 2020 election. This decision comes as no surprise, and it’s why we need to fix the broken Supreme Court — because who knows what comes next. | For a long time, the Supreme Court delayed taking on this case, a circumstance that would have allowed Trump to potentially pardon himself if he wins in November. Finally, they decided to take it on. Many had hoped they would rule against granting him “absolute immunity.”Instead, the Court gave Trump its absolute support to utilize the Oval Office for his own personal and political gain if he’s re-elected. So what does all this mean? This means that Donald Trump’s ongoing criminal prosecutions could be delayed, and his 34 felony counts could be greatly undermined. But even more importantly, a Trump victory in November now means that he enters the White House with “absolute immunity” for his official actions as President. Emboldened and unbound by any appearance of needing to adhere to the rule of law. It’s a disgrace, and moreover, it’s dangerous for someone who has said they would be a dictator on "Day 1.” Trump has spent his entire life believing that his power and wealth could protect him from prosecution — and now the Supreme Court is telling him that yes, he is indeed above the law. I’ve had more than enough of the Supreme Court’s decisions that move us further back in time and erode the foundational principles that this country is supposed to uphold. I’m proud to stand up for real reform to the Supreme Court. That includes legislation to expand the number of justices on the Supreme Court and enforce a code of ethics for the justices. Thank you for stepping up today. Now more than ever, we need to use our collective power to speak out and demand change. — Tina Smith Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota Tina Smith for Minnesota PO Box 14362 St. Paul, MN 55114 United States | | Contributions or gifts to Tina Smith for Minnesota are not tax-deductible.

subject: Campaign Update
body:
Kenosha 4th of July Parade, Racine GOP Office Opening, Honoring the Fallen, and a look ahead to more parades in MIlwaukee County on Thursday! | | | | |
---
| Happy Monday!
Here’s another update from the campaign trail.
**Kenosha 4th of July Parade** Before we stepped off for the parade, we met at Kennedy Park to rally with Eric Hovde, our local candidates, and our grassroots volunteers. I’m very grateful for all of our supporters in Kenosha County.
---
| Then, we headed over to the parade and got ready to step off.
Team Steil had a great crew and we enjoyed celebrating independence day with the thousands of people who came out to the Kenosha parade!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| **Racine GOP Office Opening** On Saturday morning, I joined the Racine GOP at their new field office opening in Mount Pleasant. Organizing at the grassroots level is going to be crucial to winning this November.
We’ve got some great volunteers and party activists in Racine County who are united, organized, and ready to win this year.
---
| **Honoring the Fallen** Last week, I worked with my colleagues to revamp the 9/11 Wall of the Fallen. This memorial displays the names of 7,054 fallen U.S. service members who gave their lives in the war on terror.
It’s a recognition of the sacrifice they made so we can cherish our freedom and liberties at home.
---
[Click Here to Learn More](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=77a11afcfd&e=e907534017)
| **Milwaukee County 4th of July Parades** I’ll be walking in FIVE parades on Thursday in Milwaukee County.
* Oak Creek ( 9:00 am )
* Franklin ( 11:00 am )
* Cudahy ( 12:00 pm )
* St. Francis ( 2:00 pm )
* Hales Corners ( 4:00 pm )

---
| We’re always looking for more people to join Team Steil and walk with us in parades.
If you’re able and willing to walk with us on the 4th of July, please reach out to **tripp@steilforwisconsin.com** and we’ll make sure you’re on the team!

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
